# Fertilizer Dose

> Calculate the exact fertilizer dose for crops, plants & vegetables. Real NPK data, acre/kanal/marla/hectare support, AI plant doctor, and region-aware planting calendars for 18 countries.

## About

Fertilizer Dose (fertilizerdose.com) is a free web tool that turns published agronomic recommendations into precise per-acre fertilizer quantities. Every NPK value is sourced and cited — no invented numbers. Unverified data shows "No verified data available yet."

## Key Tools

- **Dose Calculator** (/calculator): Pick your crop, enter land area (acre, kanal, marla, hectare), get exact urea, DAP, MOP quantities plus stage-wise application schedule.
- **Planting Calendar** (/planting-calendar): Region-aware sowing calendar with activity types (sow, transplant, harvest). Filter by country, region, month, category.
- **What to Grow This Month**: Homepage widget showing what to plant now based on selected country/region.
- **Profit Calculator** (/profit-calculator): Estimate crop profitability (user-entered prices/yields — planning estimates only).
- **Compare** (/compare): Compare fertilizers side by side (user-entered prices).
- **Plant Doctor** (/plant-doctor): AI-powered plant disease diagnosis from photos.
- **My Garden** (/my-garden): Track plots, plantings, reminders, saved calculations.

## Coverage

- **18 countries**: Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, United States, Brazil, Indonesia, Australia, China, Türkiye, Malaysia, Japan, South Korea, Spain, France, Germany, Italy, Poland, Russia
- **Crops**: wheat, rice, maize, cotton, sugarcane, potato, soybean, groundnut, barley, canola, sunflower, jute, mustard, lentil, chickpea, rye, triticale, durum wheat, sugar beet, and more
- **Vegetables**: tomato, onion, garlic, chili, okra, peas, carrot, spinach, brinjal, cucumber, cauliflower, cabbage, radish, daikon, napa cabbage
- **Plants**: rose, marigold, money plant, mango, neem, coffee, palm oil, rubber, olive, grape, citrus

## Data Standards

- All fertilizer recommendations cite named sources (government extension, agricultural universities, FAO, peer-reviewed research).
- Nutrient values in kg N–P₂O₅–K₂O per hectare (oxide basis, explicitly labeled).
- Imported data enters as draft/under_review; only verified data is published.
- Gaps are honestly marked — never filled with guesses.

## Languages

Available in 18 languages: English, Urdu, Hindi, Punjabi, Bengali, Arabic, Turkish, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Russian, Portuguese, Indonesian, Malay, Chinese, Japanese, Korean.

## Technical

- Built with Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma + PostgreSQL
- Light/dark mode, RTL support for Arabic/Urdu
- Mobile-responsive
